entry.desc: Chemistry constituent receiving each MEGAN VOC emission flux field imported from the coupler (Fall_voc), one entry per field, in the order of the drv_flds_in megan_specifier entries. CAM resolves this mapping from shr_megan_mechcomps; here it is namelist-provided since the shr_megan tables are not visible to CCPP schemes. Default: 'SOAE' (the single MEGAN mechanism compound of trop_mam4).
